title: Hide Your Hands
description: Switch the visibility of held items and armor using hotkeys.
body:
# Hide Your Hands

**Toggle visibility of held items and armor with hotkeys**

---

## 🎮 Features

- Toggle hiding of items in your hands (main hand / off hand) using a hotkey.  
- Toggle hiding of armor visually.  
- Works in both first-person and third-person views.  
- Client-side only: no server permissions required.  
- Notifications when hiding/showing in English & Russian.

---

## 🔧 Hotkeys & Usage

| Action                            | Default Key |
|----------------------------------|-------------|
| Toggle hands/items visibility    | `H`         |
| Toggle armor visibility          | `J`         |

Press once to hide, press again to show. Visibility changes when you press the key.

---

## 🛠 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20.4** (Fabric)  
- Java **17**  
- Fabric API compatible with your Minecraft version

---

## 🔍 Why Use This Mod?

- Cleaner screenshots and video recordings — less clutter.  
- More immersive builds / exploration when you don’t want to see gear.  
- Minimal aesthetic.  

---

## ⚠ Compatibility & Notes

- Only affects visual display on your client. Others may still see your items/armor if they don't have this mod.  
- Make sure mixins are configured properly for hiding armor and items.

---

## 📝 About

**Hide Your Hands** by *[Tw1l](https://t.me/tw1lti)*

---

*Thank you for trying Hide Your Hands!*
